description: This is a Java test class for the CCServices component, testing interactions with the ClearCommerce payment gateway including authorization, credit, subscription purchase, and report retrieval.

classes.name: CCServicesTest
classes.description: A JUnit test case class for testing ClearCommerce payment services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data including payment info, addresses, and order details before each test.

methods.name: testAuth
methods.description: Tests authorization of a credit card transaction via clearCommerceCCAuth service.

methods.name: testCredit
methods.description: Tests crediting (deducting) an amount from a credit card via clearCommerceCCCredit service.

methods.name: testPurchaseSubscription
methods.description: Tests purchasing a subscription using clearCommerceCCCredit service with subscription parameters.

methods.name: testFreeSubscription
methods.description: Placeholder for testing free subscription; currently does not communicate with CC.

methods.name: testCancelSubscription
methods.description: Placeholder for testing subscription cancellation; not implemented as cancellation is manual.

methods.name: testCCReport
methods.description: Tests querying the status of a subscription transaction via clearCommerceCCReport service.
